userStories.title: Bot runs write a prompt audit
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Give bot review and fix runtimes their PR feature name so enabled prompt auditing uses the existing real auditor, and warn when enabled audit lacks its required identity.

**Motivation** — The native agent already archives full transcripts (`agent.transcriptAudit`), so the gap hurts ACP runs most: they leave no nax-side record of the prompt.

**Approach** — **Prompt audit for bot runs (#2683).** `reviewCheckout` calls `deps.createRuntime(config, repoRoot, { featureName: `bot-pr-${ref.number}` })`; `fixCheckout` does the same. In `createRuntime`, the branch that falls back to the no-op auditor logs one warning when `config.agent?.promptAudit?.enabled` is true and neither `opts.featureName` nor `opts.promptAuditor` is set: `_runtimeLoggerDeps.getSafeLogger()?.warn("runtime", "Prompt audit is enabled but no feature name was given; prompts will not be audited", { workdir })`. `_runtimeLoggerDeps` is a new exported seam in `src/runtime/index.ts`, `export const _runtimeLoggerDeps = { getSafeLogger }`, following `_packagesDeps` in `src/runtime/packages.ts`; tests replace its `getSafeLogger` instead of mocking the module. It is one call per `createRuntime` call. No other behaviour of `createRuntime` changes.

**Interface** — Keep `CreateRuntimeOptions.featureName?: string` and `CreateRuntimeOptions.promptAuditor?` unchanged. Add `getSafeLogger` to the file's existing `../logger` import, which today imports only `getLogger`. The exact new seam and target factory calls are:
```typescript
export const _runtimeLoggerDeps = { getSafeLogger };
const runtime = deps.createRuntime(config, repoRoot, { featureName: `bot-pr-${ref.number}` });
```
The target call replaces `const runtime = deps.createRuntime(config, repoRoot);` in both `reviewCheckout` (`src/bot/review-run.ts`) and `fixCheckout` (`src/bot/fix-run.ts`). In the existing final auditor-selection branch, retain `createNoOpPromptAuditor()` and issue the specified warning only when `auditEnabled` is true; that branch is reached only when `opts?.promptAuditor` is unset and `opts?.featureName` is falsy.

Failure handling: Prompt audit enabled, `createRuntime` given neither `featureName` nor `promptAuditor`: No-op auditor as today, plus the one `warn` from Approach 1; the runtime is still returned. `_runtimeLoggerDeps.getSafeLogger()` returns `null` when that warning fires: nothing is logged and `createRuntime` does not throw.

Implementation tests are part of this story: create `packages/nax/test/integration/bot/review-run-prompt-audit.test.ts`, `packages/nax/test/integration/bot/fix-run-prompt-audit.test.ts`, and `packages/nax/test/unit/runtime/runtime-prompt-audit.test.ts`. Drive public runBotReview/runBotFix with the existing bot deps helpers and a mock factory returning the helper runtime. Restore injected dependencies and close real runtimes in unit tests. US-001 changes no existing test: createRuntime keeps returning the same runtime, the bot deps helpers stub createRuntime with a function that ignores its arguments, and no existing test asserts the arguments the bot passes to createRuntime or that no warning is logged.

**Scope** — In: the two bot runtime call sites, exported logger seam, warning in the no-op branch, and their behavioral tests. Out: prompt sections and prompt wording (US-002/US-003), required-file policy (US-004), the bot fix prompt, other factory callers gaining feature names, ACP transcript auditing, and any session or permission behavior changes.
acceptanceCriteria: [integration] runBotReview, driven with the bot review deps helper (test/helpers/bot-review.ts, PR number 7) and _botReviewDeps.createRuntime replaced by a mock returning the helper's runtime, calls createRuntime with a third argument equal to { featureName: "bot-pr-7" }.

[integration] runBotFix, driven with the bot fix deps helper (test/helpers/bot-fix.ts, PR number 42) and _botFixDeps.createRuntime replaced by a mock returning the helper's runtime, calls createRuntime with a third argument equal to { featureName: "bot-pr-42" }.

[unit] createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled true and no options, with _runtimeLoggerDeps.getSafeLogger returning a test logger, logs exactly one warn on it with stage "runtime" and message "Prompt audit is enabled but no feature name was given; prompts will not be audited".
[unit] The warning logged by createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled true and no options carries { workdir } as its data, where workdir is the second argument given to createRuntime.
[unit] createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled true and { featureName: "bot-pr-42" } logs no warning with that message.
[unit] createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled true, a supplied promptAuditor and no featureName logs no warning with that message.
[unit] createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled false and no options logs no warning with that message.

[unit] createRuntime with agent.promptAudit.enabled true and no options, with _runtimeLoggerDeps.getSafeLogger returning null, returns a runtime whose promptAuditor is the no-op auditor and does not throw.

[unit] When createRuntime is called with agent.promptAudit.enabled true, neither featureName nor promptAuditor, and an available test logger, it still returns a runtime whose promptAuditor is the no-op auditor after emitting the specified warning.

routing.reasoning: Three small source changes reuse existing runtime options and logger injection patterns; integration tests pin the two orchestration call sites. No new auditing abstraction, permission policy or security-sensitive session logic is introduced.

userStories.title: Bot review reaches beyond the diff and into the tests
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add the shared Beyond the diff text and bot-only Tests section to normal and static bot code-review prompts, preserving conversation-only and workflow branch prompts.

**Motivation** — The gap is where it looks, not what it can do.

**Approach** — **"Beyond the diff" section (#2682 A).** A new exported constant `WORKFLOW_BEYOND_DIFF_SECTION` in `src/prompts/builders/workflow-quality-checklist.ts`, re-exported from `src/prompts/index.ts`. It lives in the shared checklist module so the two review engines draw review text from one place; only the bot prompt embeds it in this spec, and the module's header comment gains one sentence saying so. Its exact text:

```
## Beyond the diff
A change is correct only if the code it did not touch still agrees with it. For every function, type, config key or contract the diff changes, and for every defect the PR description says it fixes:
- Search the repository for the other callers of each changed or wrapped function, and for other sites with the same pattern, including files the diff does not touch. A fix applied at some sites but not at others is a finding: quote the missed site.
- Check that callers and callees still agree, and that every new piece is reachable from where it is meant to be used.
- If the repository already solves the same problem elsewhere, for example in a helper or a sibling module the PR also changes, compare the new code with that solution and report where it is weaker.
- List the files you opened outside the diff in inspectedFiles.
```

**"Tests" section (#2682 B).** A bot-only section built in `src/prompts/builders/bot-pr-review-builder.ts`. Text when `staticMode` is false:

```
## Tests
Read the test changes, not only the source. For each behaviour the PR changes and each defect it says it fixes:
- Name the test that covers it, and check that the test asserts the outcome the change promises (the returned value or the data kept), not only that the call returns or how long it took.
- Run that test file with the project's test command, scoped to the file. If you cannot run it, list it in cannotVerify as "not run: <test file>: <reason>".
A changed behaviour with no test that would fail without the change is a finding.
```

When `staticMode` is true, the same text without the `- Run that test file ...` bullet (a static review has no shell tool).

**Placement.** When `conversationOnly` is not true, `projectSections` emits, in order: `CHECKLIST`, `WORKFLOW_QUALITY_CHECKLIST`, `WORKFLOW_ENUMERATION_INSTRUCTION`, `WORKFLOW_BEYOND_DIFF_SECTION`, the Tests section, then the existing optional sections (earlier-findings note, project checks, checkout state, CI, settled rulings, decisions). A conversation-only prompt gets neither new section.

**Interface** — `src/prompts/builders/workflow-quality-checklist.ts` gains `export const WORKFLOW_BEYOND_DIFF_SECTION: string`; `src/prompts/index.ts` re-exports it beside `WORKFLOW_QUALITY_CHECKLIST`. `BotPrReviewPromptInput` is unchanged. The constant is consumed by the bot builder in this story, not left as an unwired export. `runPrReview` already sends the built prompt to the op; verify that path with `_workflowDeps.callOp` scripted to return a valid verdict.

Add prompt cases to the existing `packages/nax/test/unit/prompts/bot-pr-review-builder.test.ts`, the workflow branch exclusion case to `packages/nax/test/unit/prompts/workflow-branch-builder.test.ts`, and the runPrReview prompt-forwarding case to `packages/nax/test/unit/bot/review-step.test.ts`. Import the new constant via `@/prompts` to pin its barrel export as well as exact content. Do not create new files.

**Scope** — In: the new shared text constant and its barrel export/header note, both Tests variants, ordered insertion in bot projectSections, and prompt/forwarding regressions. Out: CI and approval-task wording (US-003), keepTests classification/wiring (US-004), runtime audit behavior (US-001), editing the two existing shared checklist constants, embedding either section in workflow branch review, changing the reply schema or session role, changing Project checks text, or granting static review a command tool.

userStories.title: Clarify green CI and require review steps before approval
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Stop the bot prompt from treating green CI as verification of changed tests, and name the reading/search prerequisites before code-review approval.

**Motivation** — Green CI shows only that the existing suite passes.

**Approach** — **Green CI wording (#2682 C).** `ciSection` gains the `conversationOnly` flag. The green verdict becomes:

```
Every CI check reported on this exact head passed; a skipped check counts as passed. The checks are listed below. Where they include the project's build, lint or test suite, treat those that ran and passed as proof that the existing suite passes: do not list them in "cannotVerify". CI does not show that the new or changed tests would fail without the change, or that every affected site was fixed.
```

When `conversationOnly` is not true, the sentence ` The Tests and Beyond the diff sections still apply.` is appended to that paragraph. The red and no-result verdicts and the fenced detail are unchanged.

**Approval line (#2682 D).** When `conversationOnly` is not true, `## Your task` gains one line directly after `Review whether the code fulfills the stated intent and assess its quality. List every file you inspected in inspectedFiles.`:

```
Before you answer "approved", read every changed test file and search outside the diff as "Beyond the diff" asks; name any step you skipped in cannotVerify.
```

`REPLY_TASK` is a constant today, so it becomes a function of `conversationOnly`; a conversation-only `## Your task` is byte-for-byte unchanged. The reply JSON schema is unchanged.

**Interface** — `BotPrReviewPromptInput` is unchanged. Thread the existing `conversationOnly` input from `projectSections` into `ciSection` and from `buildBotPrReviewPrompt` into the task-rendering function. The new CI sentence and approval line name the sections supplied by upstream US-002.

Modify exactly the affected existing expectations in `packages/nax/test/unit/prompts/bot-pr-review-builder.test.ts`: (1) "US-014 AC-9 preserves checklist items 1-5 and the entire task/JSON contract verbatim" builds the non-conversation `base` prompt and pins the whole `## Your task` slice; the expected slice gains the line `Before you answer "approved", read every changed test file and search outside the diff as "Beyond the diff" asks; name any step you skipped in cannotVerify.` directly after the line `Review whether the code fulfills the stated intent and assess its quality. List every file you inspected in inspectedFiles.`. Every other line of the slice, and the checklist items 1-5 assertion, stay unchanged. (2) "green CI claims only what CI reported, and lets the check names decide coverage" expects `only those that ran and passed are verified: do not list them in "cannotVerify"`; that expectation becomes `treat those that ran and passed as proof that the existing suite passes: do not list them in "cannotVerify"`. The test's other expectations (the heading line, the fenced detail, no "full checks already passed") stay unchanged. Add the new normal/conversation CI and task-line cases to this same existing file; compare conversation-only task text with the complete pre-change text, not merely absence of the new line.

**Scope** — In: green-CI paragraph, its code-review-only suffix, task rendering with its code-review-only approval line, and exact text regressions. Out: adding/reordering the new sections (US-002), required-file coverage policy (US-004), runtime audit wiring (US-001), red/no-result CI or detail-fencing changes, any reply-schema change including an observed field, changes to Project checks text, and changing the conversation-only task contract. Retaining the existing red-CI verdict is a negative-path regression assertion, not a request to alter that verdict.

The checks are listed below. Where they include the project's build, lint or test suite, treat those that ran and passed as proof that the existing suite passes: do not list them in "cannotVerify". CI does not show that the new or changed tests would fail without the change, or that every affected site was fixed.

userStories.title: Require changed test files in bot review coverage
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make changed test files part of the bot's required reading and existing coverage retry without changing workflow branch coverage or the review verdict policy.

**Motivation** — The bot review calls the same function with no story layer underneath, so reading only `src/` satisfies coverage.

**Approach** — **Test files are required reading (#2682 B, enforced in code).** `reviewRequiredFiles` gains an optional third parameter `options?: { readonly keepTests?: boolean }`. With `keepTests: true` it does not resolve test patterns and keeps every path except the documentation, lockfile and image/document basenames it already drops. Without the option the function behaves as today. `runPrReview` (`src/bot/review-step.ts`) calls it with `{ keepTests: true }`; `runBranchReview` (`src/workflow/branch-review.ts`) keeps calling it without options. The existing coverage retry in `botPrReviewOp` / `botPrStaticReviewOp` then asks the reviewer to read any changed test file it skipped, and `unreadFiles` reports it when it still does not.

**Interface** — Target from the spec: `reviewRequiredFiles(paths, fc, options?: { readonly keepTests?: boolean }): Promise<string[]>`. Preserve the existing concrete input types and add only the optional options argument:
```typescript
export async function reviewRequiredFiles(
  paths: readonly string[],
  fc: Pick<FeatureContext, "config" | "projectDir" | "packageDirs">,
  options?: { readonly keepTests?: boolean },
): Promise<string[]>
```
`runPrReview` target: `requiredFiles = await reviewRequiredFiles(paths, ctx, { keepTests: true });`. The branch review's `reviewRequiredFiles(paths, fc)` call must not change. With `keepTests: false`, use the same behavior as the omitted option, including package-specific test classification, cached resolution and widening on resolver failure. With true, do not call `_workflowDeps.resolveTestPatterns` at all. Preserve input order and existing non-source filtering.

Failure handling: The reviewer still skips a changed test file after the coverage retry: Verdict kept as today; the file is in `unreadFiles`, which the review summary already lists as not read. Existing coverage retry and exhaustedFallback behavior provide this; do not add an approval-to-changes guard, change the reply shape, or add shell tools to static review.

Add classifier cases to `packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/review-coverage.test.ts` and bot dispatch/unread cases to `packages/nax/test/unit/bot/review-step.test.ts`. Modify the existing "US-015 AC-6/9 classifies changed paths and reports unread files" case for both `staticMode` values: it expects requiredFiles and unreadFiles to be the two paths pkg/main.go and settings.json, with the test file pkg/main_test.go dropped; the bot review now keeps test files, so both become the three paths pkg/main.go, pkg/main_test.go and settings.json, in that order. README.md stays dropped, and the `repoRoot` and `range` expectations are unchanged. Use the suite's scripted `_workflowDeps.callOp` seam and restore deps between cases; add no new test files. For the retained-verdict failure case, script the final op result with an approved verdict that still omits the test and assert `result.verdict` equals that verdict. `runPrReview` does not execute retries itself: the unchanged op owns retry exhaustion, already protected by the existing `US-015 AC-1–5 coverage retries follow triage, remain optional and retain exhausted findings` case in `packages/nax/test/unit/operations/bot-pr-review.test.ts` for both review ops. The classifier/wiring changes must preserve that behavior.

**Scope** — In: additive keepTests option, bot call-site opt-in, unchanged default/false classification, normal/static requiredFiles wiring, and unread-file/retained-verdict behavior. Out: runtime audit work (US-001), prompt sections/CI/approval wording (US-002/US-003), changing runBranchReview's policy or prompt, changing the shared retry algorithm, converting an approved verdict to changes for unread files, new summary formats, or new cost limits.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] reviewRequiredFiles(["pkg/main.go", "pkg/main_test.go"], fc, { keepTests: true }), where package pkg is configured with test patterns matching _test.go, returns ["pkg/main.go", "pkg/main_test.go"], without invoking test-pattern resolution.
[unit] reviewRequiredFiles(["README.md", "bun.lock", "logo.png", "src/a.ts"], fc, { keepTests: true }) returns ["src/a.ts"].
[unit] reviewRequiredFiles with { keepTests: true } never calls _workflowDeps.resolveTestPatterns.
[unit] reviewRequiredFiles(["pkg/main.go", "pkg/main_test.go"], fc) with no options, where pkg resolves test patterns matching _test.go, returns ["pkg/main.go"].
[unit] reviewRequiredFiles(["pkg/main.go", "pkg/main_test.go"], fc, { keepTests: false }), where pkg resolves test patterns matching _test.go, returns ["pkg/main.go"].

[unit] runPrReview with staticMode false, a review package listing pkg/main.go, pkg/main_test.go, README.md and settings.json, and test patterns matching _test.go, calls the op with requiredFiles equal to ["pkg/main.go", "pkg/main_test.go", "settings.json"].

[unit] When the review op returns a usable verdict with quality "approved" whose inspectedFiles still omits required pkg/main_test.go after its existing coverage retry, runPrReview returns that same verdict unchanged in result.verdict, preserving the approved quality as today.

README.md stays dropped, and the `repoRoot` and `range` expectations are unchanged.

analysis:
This is an enhancement to @nathapp/nax, closing #2682 and #2683, not a greenfield project. All implementation and tests belong in packages/nax; no changes are needed in nax-agent, nax-agent-acp or nax-ai. The binding decomposition is exactly US-001 through US-004, with only US-003 depending on US-002. Codebase-memory MCP tools were unavailable, so discovery used direct reads and repository text search. The checked-out files agree with the spec's baseline.

Goal and review architecture: a bot code review must be the full code check for ranges without story review underneath: non-workflow PRs, commits after a workflow-reviewed head, and full re-reviews. Merely inspecting changed source files can miss sibling callers and partial fixes; green CI proves the existing suite passes, not that changed tests assert the intended outcome or would fail without the fix. Preserve the distinct conversation-only path, which must not acquire a fresh code-review remit. Success means the normal and static bot prompts require outside-diff searches and reading changed tests, command-capable reviews require scoped test runs, required-file coverage includes changed tests for bot code reviews, and bot review/fix runtimes receive their already-established bot-pr-<number> identity for prompt auditing. The manual replay on #2680 is deliberately not an automated acceptance test.

US-001 runtime/audit wiring: packages/nax/src/bot/review-run.ts:410-415 shows reviewCheckout loading its effective config and calling deps.createRuntime(config, repoRoot); packages/nax/src/bot/fix-run.ts:353-357 shows the analogous fixCheckout call. Add the third options argument without changing the first two arguments, checkout config handling, setup or cleanup. The deps entry is already typed through the real factory (packages/nax/src/bot/review-deps.ts:14,70), and _botFixDeps reuses that function (packages/nax/src/bot/fix-run.ts:50), so no new factory interface is necessary. Both checkout orchestrators retain their existing runtime.close lifecycle (review: packages/nax/src/bot/review-run.ts:442-450). CreateRuntimeOptions already accepts promptAuditor and featureName (packages/nax/src/runtime/index.ts:291-305). createRuntime currently chooses custom auditor first, enabled audit plus truthy featureName second, and no-op otherwise (packages/nax/src/runtime/index.ts:347-357). Add only a conditional warning to that final branch. Export _runtimeLoggerDeps = { getSafeLogger }, adding getSafeLogger beside getLogger at packages/nax/src/runtime/index.ts:114-115. packages/nax/src/runtime/packages.ts:5-7 provides the existing logger-dependency seam precedent. getSafeLogger has a nullable return (packages/nax/src/logger/logger.ts:513), so use optional chaining; an absent safe logger must not cause a throw. Warning data uses the original second argument, workdir, and there is one warning call per qualifying createRuntime invocation, not a global once-only suppression. Keep custom auditor precedence and disabled-audit behavior unchanged. Runtime dispatch already subscribes the selected prompt auditor (packages/nax/src/runtime/index.ts:450-454). buildPrStepContext already supplies featureName: label to wiring and callCtx, using label = bot-pr-${input.pr.number} (packages/nax/src/workflow/pr-step-context.ts:43-54,60-68); do not duplicate or alter that identity mechanism. The existing PromptAuditor and no-op implementation require no changes (packages/nax/src/runtime/prompt-auditor.ts:98-109); no new transcript implementation or permission/session behavior is part of this story.

US-001 tests: reuse makeBotReviewDeps, which fixes the PR ref at 7 and stubs createRuntime with an argument-ignoring function (packages/nax/test/helpers/bot-review.ts:8-16,34-35), and makeBotFixEnv/makeBotFixDeps, which use PR 42 and similarly stub the factory (packages/nax/test/helpers/bot-fix.ts:6-9,76-94). Mock the relevant factory dep to return the helper runtime, then exercise runBotReview/runBotFix and assert the third argument. Do not merely test private checkout helpers. Create only packages/nax/test/integration/bot/review-run-prompt-audit.test.ts, packages/nax/test/integration/bot/fix-run-prompt-audit.test.ts and packages/nax/test/unit/runtime/runtime-prompt-audit.test.ts. These files do not exist today. No existing test changes are needed for US-001. The existing runtime suite already tracks and closes created runtimes (packages/nax/test/unit/runtime/runtime.test.ts:16-30); follow that lifecycle in the concern-specific suite, restore _runtimeLoggerDeps after each case, and use a test logger without mocking the logger module. The existing runtime.test.ts is 648 lines and the spec identifies review-run.test.ts as 731 lines, motivating concern-specific test files rather than unrelated bug-number suites.

US-002 prompt composition and consumers: packages/nax/src/prompts/builders/workflow-quality-checklist.ts:1-9 describes shared review text, and :11-33 holds the existing checklist, enumeration instruction and design-decisions item.
